```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
offenses <- read_csv(here('offense_segment.csv'))
batches <- read_csv(here('nibrs_batch_header_1991_2024.csv')) %>% 
  filter(grepl('200[0-5]', year))
```

```{r}
offenses_filtered <- batches_filtered %>% 
  left_join(offenses) %>% 
  drop_na(year)

# All the assault and vandalism cases
offenses_filtered <- offenses_filtered %>%
 filter(grepl('assault|vandalism', ucr_offense_code))
```

```{r}
library(cfbfastR)

espn <- c()
years <- 2000:2005

for (year in years) {
  i = year %% 2000 + 1
  espn[[i]] = espn_cfb_schedule(
    year = year
  )
}

names(espn) = c('2000', '2001', '2002', '2003', '2004', '2005')

espn2 <- bind_rows(espn, .id='year')

espn2 <- espn2 %>% 
  mutate(
    home_team_name = case_when(
      home_team_id == "2711" ~ "Broncos2", # Boise and western michigan have the same team name so im replacing western michigan with Broncos2
      TRUE ~ home_team_name
    )
  )
```

```{r}

# community populations and regions

  ~university, ~region, 
    'the university of akron', 'Midwest',
  'iowa state university', 'Midwest',

  'ohio university', 'Midwest', 
  'the university of texas at austin', 'Southwest',
  'virginia polytechnic institute and state university', 'Southeast',
  'boise state university', 'West',
  'clemson university', 'Southeast',
  'united states air force academy', 'West',
  'the university of south carolina', 'Southeast',
  'the ohio state university', 'Midwest',
  'the university of north texas', 'Southwest',
  'michigan state university', 'Midwest',
  'university of arkansas', 'Southeast',
  'marshall university', 'southeast',
  'the university of iowa', 'midwest',
  'arkansas state university', 'Southeast', 
  'western michigan university', 'Midwest',
  'the university of kansas', 'Midwest',
  'utah state university', 'West', 
  'texas tech university', 'Southwest',
  'west virginia university', 'Southeast',
  'the university of idaho', 'West',
  'eastern michigan university', 'Midwest',
  'middle tennessee state university', 'Southeast',
  'brigham young university', 'West' 
)

# one way - community population
table1_data <- offenses_filtered2 %>% 
  select(year, city_name, university, home_team_name, current_population_1) %>% 
  group_by(city_name, university, home_team_name) %>% 
  summarize(mean_pop=mean(current_population_1)) %>%
  mutate(
    community_population = case_when(
      (mean_pop < 50000) ~ '<50000',
      (mean_pop > 50000 & mean_pop < 100000) ~ '50000-100000',
      (mean_pop > 100000 & mean_pop < 200000) ~ '100000-200000',
      (mean_pop > 200000 & mean_pop < 500000) ~ '200000-500000',
      TRUE ~ '>500000'
    )
  ) %>% 
  left_join(regions, by='university')

# another way - commmunity population
table1_2_data <- offenses_filtered2 %>% 
  filter(year == '2005') %>% 
  select(city_name, university, home_team_name, current_population_1) %>% 
  unique() %>%
  mutate(
    community_population = case_when(
      (current_population_1 < 50000) ~ '<50000',
      (current_population_1 > 50000 & current_population_1 < 100000) ~ '50000-100000',
      (current_population_1 > 100000 & current_population_1 < 200000) ~ '100000-200000',
      (current_population_1 > 200000 & current_population_1 < 500000) ~ '200000-500000',
      TRUE ~ '>500000'
    )
  ) %>% 
  left_join(regions, by='university')
```

```{r}
# rankings

rankings <- c()
for (year in years) {
  i <- year %% 2000 + 1
  temp <- cfbd_rankings(year = year)
  rankings[[i]] <- temp %>% 
    filter(season_type == 'regular') %>% 
    group_by(school) %>% 
    mutate(best_rank=min(rank)) %>% 
    select(school, best_rank)
}

names(rankings) <- c('2000', '2001', '2002', '2003', '2004', '2005')

rankings_2000_2005 <- bind_rows(rankings, .id='year')

school_name_lookup <- tribble(
  ~university, ~school,
  'the university of akron', 'Akron',
  'iowa state university', 'Iowa State',
  'the university of michigan', 'Michigan',
  'ohio university', 'Ohio',
  'the university of texas at austin', 'Texas',
  'virginia polytechnic institute and state university', 'Virginia Tech',
  'boise state university', 'Boise State',
  'clemson university', 'Clemson',
  'united states air force academy', 'Air Force',
  'the university of south carolina', 'South Carolina',
  'the ohio state university', 'Ohio State',
  'the university of north texas', 'North Texas',
  'michigan state university', 'Michigan State',
  'university of arkansas', 'Arkansas',
  'marshall university', 'Marshall',
  'the university of iowa', 'Iowa',
  'arkansas state university', 'Arkansas State',
  'western michigan university', 'Western Michigan',
  'the university of kansas', 'Kansas',
  'utah state university', 'Utah State',
  'texas tech university', 'Texas Tech',
  'west virginia university', 'West Virginia',
  'the university of idaho', 'Idaho',
  'eastern michigan university', 'Eastern Michigan',
  'middle tennessee state university', 'Middle Tennessee',
  'brigham young university', 'BYU'
)

# best ranking for each 14 program
ranking_data <- offenses_filtered2 %>% 
  select(year, university, home_team_name) %>% 
  left_join(school_name_lookup, by='university') %>%
  left_join(rankings_2000_2005, by=c('year', 'school')) %>% 
  group_by(university, home_team_name) %>% 
  summarize(rank_category = min(best_rank, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(rank_category = if_else(is.infinite(rank_category), NA_real_, rank_category)) %>%
  mutate(
    ranking = case_when(
      (rank_category <= 25) ~ '1-25',
      (rank_category <= 50) ~ '25-50',
      (rank_category <= 75) ~ '50-75',
      (rank_category <= 125) ~ '75-125',
      TRUE ~ 'Not ranked'
    )
  ) %>% 
  select(university, ranking)

table1_data <- table1_data %>% 
  left_join(ranking_data)
```

```{r}
# venue data
venues <- cfbd_venues()

all_cities <- offenses_filtered2$city_name %>% unique()

venues_filtered <- venues %>% 
  mutate(city=tolower(city)) %>% 
  select(name, capacity, city) %>% 
  rename(venue_name=name, city_name=city) %>%
  inner_join(offenses_filtered2, by='city_name') %>% 
  select(university, home_team_id, city_name, venue_name, capacity) %>% 
  distinct()


venues_filtered %>% 
  group_by(university) %>% 
  summarize(count = n())
```
